modmenu.descriptionTranslation.explorerm: Camera-based fog-of-discovery mini-map HUD. Hold a filled map in your off-hand to reveal the world as you look at it.
explorermap.cartography_table.instructio: Expand coverage or add waypoint capacity
explorermap.expansion.hd_cost: HD mode: Paper + Ink Sac + Compass per expansion
text.autoconfig.explorermap.title: Explorer Map Settings
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.showH: Display the mini-map HUD when a filled map is in the off-hand.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.corne: Which corner of the screen the mini-map appears in.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.mapSi: Side length of the mini-map in screen pixels (60–240).
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.paddi: Gap between the mini-map and the screen edge.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.opaci: Overall transparency of the mini-map overlay (20–100).
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.hideW: Automatically hide the mini-map while the player is sneaking.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.hideI: Hide the mini-map whenever a screen or menu is open.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.fogOf: Only reveal map pixels the player has actually looked at. Disable to mark all visited chunks as discovered.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.disco: How many game ticks between discovery ray-cast updates. Lower values are more accurate but use more CPU (1–20).
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.rayCo: Number of horizontal rays cast per update. Higher values catch more pixels at the edges of the field of view (8–64).
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.showE: Show directional arrows around the mini-map indicating where the coverage can be expanded.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.maxEx: Maximum number of expanded map tiles shown in the mini-map and full map (16–512, default 256). Expansions beyond this limit are not displayed, and a warning is logged when the limit is reached. The server synchronizes at most 256 maps per expansion family, so larger families are only partially synchronized.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.showC: Show a compass rose overlay on the mini-map.
Show the player X, Y, and Z coordinates beside the mini-map.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.highl: Make recently observed map pixels brighter than older discoveries.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.showG: Overlay a coordinate grid on the mini-map and full map.
text.autoconfig.explorermap.option.gridS: Choose chunk-sized or four-chunk grid cells.
explorermap.expansion.fail.cycle_detecte: Would reconnect to an existing map
explorermap.expansion.fail.no_table: Stand next to a cartography table
explorermap.expansion.fail.on_cooldown: Wait a moment before expanding again
explorermap.expansion.fail.family_full: This map cannot be expanded any further
